events.title: Grasberg Disruptions Weigh on FCX's Q1 Volumes: What Lies Ahead?
events.body: FCX cuts 2026 copper sales outlook after Grasberg disruptions hit volumes, despite stronger copper and gold prices boosting Q1 results.
